description: Oil and Gas Infrastructure is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Spatial Services (DCS). The Oil and Gas Pipelines dataset contains the spatial locations of existing and proposed onshore and offshore oil and gas pipelines within Australia and its marine territories. Pipeline data has been provided by Petrosys GPinfo as of 22 June 2026. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Spatial Services (DCS). Its tags are Australia, Energy, Foundation Data, Geospatial, Liquids. It offers 2 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
